answer: I would anchor identity in license-plate parking proof at a geofenced lot. A camera at a geofenced parking lot photographs the vehicle's plate and countersigns the entry with a timestamp. A farm must drive a distinct plated vehicle to a real lot per copy, and one plate on two accounts is an instant flag. The trick is the relic: it cannot be copied, only repeated at full price, so the farm's ocean grows with every clone while its reward stays flat and the river is a cost curve that outruns the payout curve.
